notes.title: Pre Dusk 1.3v
notes.notes:
Here is the changes and bug fixing :

UI input (Pause menu) fixed. 
Level 2 roof spikes fixed.
Level 1 elevator roof spikes removed.
Level 1 house exterior fixed (Morning scene).
Level 4 the player can use grappler while flying in wind.
Level 4 platforms in elevator scene fixed.
Level 4 elevator scene has arrows to show you the path now.
reduce 300mb from the game size.


------------- NOTE -----------------
if you played the game please consider leaving a review for the game to know the players feedback!

notes.title: Pre Dusk 1.2V
notes.notes:
-----------------Bugs fixed-------------------  
Level 1 NPC collider /  Level 1 Rook boss (First boss) Colliders / Level 2 Ice Heart (Second Boss) Colliders / Level 3 Root (3rd Boss) log attack fixed
------------------ Things added -------------
Text fonts for dialogues

Chapter section: You will got the access to Chapter  section if you defeated the game. 

Note: if you defeated the game already and didn't get the access to Chapters section go and enter continue u will be watching the last cinematic. after you finish you will be able to play any chapter you want again.

notes.title: New Demo Soon
notes.notes:
Hello Players!.

I want to thank everyone who tried the first demo.
I know it was not that good for some players 

This month I will publish a new demo for the game with new features (New UI | new abilities | Level system)
Now you can get new abilities for each time you level up!

+ New character animations.

I hope you will love it! 

Note: if anyone experienced issues in the demo please let me know in the community hub on Steam.

Thank you.

Okba.
